tools.name: catalog_overview
tools.description: Catalog-wide counts (phages, proteins, families, datasets) and the dataset list. Start here.

tools.name: search_phages
tools.description: Find phages matching filters (host, taxonomy, lifestyle, dataset, length, GC, AMR/virulence-free...). Paged rows.

tools.name: cohort_report
tools.description: Summarise a filtered phage cohort: size, composition breakdowns and a few sample rows.

tools.name: aggregate_phages
tools.description: Count phages grouped by 1-3 dimensions (dataset, lifestyle, host rank...), optionally filtered.

tools.name: get_phage
tools.description: Full metadata for one phage: taxonomy, host lineage, lifestyle, quality, cluster, dataset.

tools.name: get_sequence
tools.description: Genome nucleotide sequence of one phage, capped at max_bases.

tools.name: search_proteins
tools.description: Proteins of one phage (optionally filtered by product text or function class), or proteins by id.

tools.name: search_families
tools.description: Find protein families by keyword (e.g. endolysin, holin), by member protein_id, or by family_id.

tools.name: family_members
tools.description: Member proteins of one family (optionally one subfamily or dataset). Paged.

tools.name: query_features
tools.description: Annotated features of one type (tRNA, CRISPR, anti-CRISPR, terminator, virulence, AMR, transmembrane).

tools.name: get_structures
tools.description: Resolve predicted (ESMFold) structure availability and links for protein ids.

tools.name: similarity_search
tools.description: Find PhageScope proteins similar to 1-50 protein sequences (MMseqs2 over ~45 M unique proteins). Returns hits within wait_seconds, otherwise a search_id for get_similarity_result.

tools.name: get_similarity_result
tools.description: Status and paged hits of a similarity_search by its search_id (kept 7 days).

tools.name: submit_analysis
tools.description: Hand a data-analysis or modelling task to the GAgent research agent, which works on read-only PhageScope data with code execution and bioinformatics tools. Returns a task_id at once; the work takes minutes to hours. Poll get_analysis_status, then read get_analysis_result. Reuse the same idempotency_

tools.name: get_analysis_status
tools.description: Status of a task: working, completed, failed or cancelled, with recent progress and when to poll again.

tools.name: get_analysis_result
tools.description: Summary, deliverables (with short-lived download links) and provenance of a finished task.

tools.name: reply_analysis
tools.description: Send a follow-up instruction to a finished, failed or cancelled task; GAgent continues in the same session with its earlier context and files. Poll get_analysis_status again afterwards.

tools.name: cancel_analysis
tools.description: Stop a working task. Deliverables already published stay available.

tools.name: list_analyses
tools.description: This token's recent analysis tasks, newest first.
